title: TreeExcavator
description: A simple tree excavator plugin, timber like
body:
![Breaking a tree](https://i.imgur.com/6v3cou9.gif)

Tree Excavator makes wood cutting faster, smoother, and far more satisfying by instantly breaking entire trees with a single block.

Perfect for survival servers, SMPs, and communities that want better gameplay without ruining Minecraft’s balance.

✨ Features
Instant Tree Cutting
Break one log and the entire connected tree is chopped automatically.

⚙️ Fully Configurable
Customize every aspect:

Supported tree types
Maximum tree size
Tool durability usage
Leaf breaking behavior
Auto replant options
Sounds & messages
Permissions
Balanced Survival Gameplay
Axes lose durability naturally for every block broken, preserving vanilla progression and balance.

Smart Tree Detection
The plugin intelligently detects connected logs and avoids breaking nearby player builds accidentally.

Performance Optimized
Designed for smooth gameplay:
Efficient block scanning
Configurable limits
Minimal server impact
